title: Company cash, delivery pay and primary industry growth (vehicle prices live in vehicles.json)

startingCash.description: Company cash granted to a new world.

deliveryPay.description: A delivery pays price x units x distance / referenceDistance, the distance being the Manhattan tiles between the station where the load started and the delivery station.

referenceDistance.description: Distance in tiles at which a unit pays exactly its price; 0 means flat pay.

minimumDistance.description: Shortest distance paid for, also used when the load origin is unknown.

industryGrowth.description: Primary industries that ship servedPercent of their monthly production for monthsToGrow months in a row gain a production level, up to maxLevel; each level adds levelStepPercent of the base output.
